name: T'zaki
description: The T'zaki were a species of sentient insectoids that shared a unified consciousness in the form of a hive mind. By the time of the Republic Era, T'zaki culture more readily accepted slavery compared to many human cultures. In 40 BBY, the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn theorized that the species' acceptance of the practice could be because T'zaki language roughly translated the term for freedom to mean having no purpose.
